scripts.text:
[Lord Knight]
Congratulations.
Honor to the warriors!
scripts.translation:
[骑士领主]
恭喜。
向战士们致敬！

scripts.text:
[Lord Knight]
We Knights have an
awesome responsibility...
To serve and protect.
scripts.translation:
[骑士领主]
我们骑士肩负着
重大的责任……
那就是服务与守护。

scripts.text:
[Lord Knight]
Even at the cost
of our own lives,
we must safeguard the
well being of our comrades.
scripts.translation:
[骑士领主]
即使要付出生命的代价，
我们也必须守护
同伴的安危。

scripts.text:
[Lord Knight]
Your time has come!
The world still needs you.
Please continue your life
as a hero with a new appearance.
scripts.translation:
[骑士领主]
你的时刻到了！
世界仍然需要你。
请以全新的面貌，
继续你作为英雄的人生。

scripts.text:
[Lord Knight]
Would you like
to become a Lord Knight?
scripts.translation:
[骑士领主]
你想成为
骑士领主吗？

scripts.text:
[Lord Knight]
When you're ready,
feel free to come back.
Honor to the warriors!
scripts.translation:
[骑士领主]
当你准备好时，
随时可以回来。
向战士们致敬！

scripts.text:
[Lord Knight]
It is still possible for you to learn more skills. Please use
all of your remaining Skill Points before returning to me.
scripts.translation:
[骑士领主]
你仍然可以学习更多技能。在回到我这里之前，请用完所有剩余的技能点数。

scripts.text:
[Lord Knight]
Congratulations!
As a Lord Knight,
I hope that you will be
at the forefront of battle,
and lead your allies to victory!
scripts.translation:
[骑士领主]
恭喜！
身为骑士领主，
我希望你能站在战斗的最前线，
带领盟友走向胜利！

scripts.text:
[Lord Knight]
Welcome
to Valhalla,
the Hall of Honor.
scripts.translation:
[骑士领主]
欢迎来到
荣誉殿堂，
瓦尔哈拉。

scripts.text:
[Lord Knight]
Please make
yourself comfortable
while you are here.
Honor to the warriors!
scripts.translation:
[骑士领主]
请在这里
好好休息。
向战士们致敬！
